input.task: Finish a web feature and decide whether it is ready.

expected_behaviors: Run relevant typecheck, lint, tests, and production build checks
Use browser QA for affected runtime journeys when available
Report metadata, forms, images, accessibility, and responsive checks when in scope
forbidden_behaviors: Mark the feature done because it compiles
Treat an unavailable browser check as a pass
Hide failed checks or omit their limitations

decision_cases.input: All applicable material checks PASS with sufficient positive evidence; no outstanding defects.
Required production build FAIL; other checks PASS.
Required material browser flow NOT_RUN; no known material failure.
All material checks PASS with sufficient evidence; only a documented non-blocking cosmetic defect remains, explicitly allowed after publication.
Required production build FAIL and required browser flow NOT_RUN.
All other checks PASS, but one known fix is mandatory before publication.

objective_checks: The gate records command, result, environment, and limitations
The final outcome is GO, GO_WITH_FIXES, NO_GO, or UNKNOWN

Evaluate each decision_cases input against the Skill decision rules without reading expected first; compare the resulting state with expected. Fixture schema validation alone is not a behavioral pass.
